reviewer: Claude review of the 22 slides the wrapping fix changed (taller source rows; titles auto-fitted where the character estimate is unreliable)

ru-sales-proposal.notes: Coherent proposal flow with a purposeful pictogram, editable process, clean comparison, and visible evidence.

ru-targeted-slide-edit.notes: Edited forecast is visually coherent while unaffected slide XML remains byte-identical to the source deck.

reviewNotes: Re-reviewed at full size: ru-board-notes 5 and 8, ru-long-copy 2, ru-process-deck 5, ru-en-mixed-business 7 — covering both kinds of change across four cases. Titles that now auto-fit read tighter and no longer run into the content beneath them; source rows carry a wrapped label clear of the divider, and a file location keeps its single line. Slide content is unchanged, so the per-case dimensions from the 2026-08-11 review still hold; ru-template-fidelity renders byte-identically and was not re-reviewed.
